title: This Ant's Sting Hurts for 24 Hours (Top of the Pain Scale)

scenes.text: This ant's sting hurts for twenty-four hours.
It's the bullet ant, and it's only an inch long.
One scientist rated its sting the worst on his pain scale: four plus.
He compared it to walking over flaming charcoal with a three-inch nail in your heel.
The venom can cause temporary loss of muscle control, and even hallucinations.
Twenty-four hours of pain, from one inch of ant.

description:
This ant's sting hurts for twenty-four hours.
Bullet ants rated 4 plus on the Schmidt pain index. Would you ever touch one?
first_comment: Bonus: the Sateré-Mawé people of Brazil use bullet ants in a rite of passage. Would you do it?
